memories.content: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 negotiation process. They aim to produce a draft agreement text that can be accepted by all parties. They have the authority to circulate draft texts to national delegations.

COP21 is the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Paris. The summit is scheduled to conclude on December 11, 2015. The French Presidency is expected to produce and circulate draft agreement texts during the conference. The final scheduled day of the summit is December 11, 2015.
